description: System archetype templates (PROJ-304). An archetype is the entire system having a flavor — distinct from the stars/planets within it. Most systems have archetype=None; a configurable percentage (default 15%) get a rolled archetype at galaxy generation. All archetype abilities are scope: system.

nebula.name: Nebula System
nebula.description: Dense gas obscures sensors and slows ships throughout the system.

ancient_battlefield.name: Ancient Battlefield
ancient_battlefield.description: Drifting debris and salvage from a long-ago war.

precursor_ruins.name: Precursor Ruins
precursor_ruins.description: Mysterious ancient technology distorts spacetime mildly.

ion_field.name: Ion Field
ion_field.description: Charged particles crackle across the system, weakening shields.

void.name: Void System
void.description: Eerily empty system; no significant intrinsic effects.
